design_decision_of_record.parity_means_same_surfaces_not_same_layo: the live class is ONE-course (core schema: classes.course_slug) so its resource band is one section; the local container is many-subject (browser-local subjectSlugs[]) and keeps per-subject sections. Both now embed the SAME resource families, the SAME deep links, and the SAME count semantics — the workspace directive ('all the tools and course resources will exist', trace 1a0ec61d5612aa6d) holds for both class concepts without pretending they have the same shape.
design_decision_of_record.counts_are_data_not_fetches_where_the_so: the past-papers index is import-bound and server-only by design (pastpapers-corpus header) — the count is computed in the server page and handed down as a plain number; the course-stats counts stay a client fetch because that API is the established cross-band payload. No new API surface invented for this.
design_decision_of_record.no_iframe_embedding: 'embed' means the workspace carries the resource rows/tools inside it exactly as the local container does — links into the real hub surfaces (the same ones students open). Iframing auth'd or corpus surfaces would be a category error the hub has never made.
design_decision_of_record.empty_archive_still_links: the student course hub drops the past-papers link at zero papers; the class workspace keeps the card linking, because the archive page's honest empty state routes to the deterministic practice papers — the honest state is on the card AND at the destination.
design_decision_of_record.cross_surface_authz_audit_still_open: T-TEACH-003's residual (non-marking teacher surfaces keep their own authorization models) remains open territory: this task adds NO new authz surface (resource cards are public corpus surfaces; the class detail page remains behind the existing teacher surface). The audit stays queued for the operator's review of the remaining queue.
